verdict.rationale: Lorikeet says it connects to your ticketing system to ingest data and take actions, and works alongside existing tools with no migration. That covers reading from and acting in an existing helpdesk. Its release notes also describe human handoff inside its own platform, which suggests a standalone mode. Missing for 10: named integrations with Zendesk, Salesforce or Intercom; explicit two-way ticket and context sync details; integration setup docs; independent or hands-on corroboration.
